data.action: 比好两本书后数零钱，把选中的一本抱在怀里。
data.description: 周末旧书摊前，圭穿杏色开衫和灰色长裙，蹲下来比较两本书的封底，再打开小零钱包数硬币。她把选中的一本抱好，满意地点了点头，黑发箍下的蓝眼明亮起来。
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane crouches at the secondhand-book stall, comparing two back covers before counting coins in a small purse. She finally hugs the selected book and nods with bright blue eyes beneath her black headband. Her apricot cardigan and calf-length grey skirt gather above brown loafers. The medium view follows low book stacks along the pavement. Reflected daylight reveals worn cover edges and cardigan knit, with soft shadows beneath the stacks.
data.title: 白银圭 · 旧书摊前的精打细算
